propositions: The current 6-job matrix (5 per-extra cells plus union) in _optionality.yml fans out across org-level concurrent job limits, causing queue delays of 6.7-8.4m for macOS slots on GitHub Free (20 total, 5 macOS concurrent)

A single venv-loop job must replace the 6 separate matrix cells, running 7 iterations (one per key in _optional.EXTRAS union {mcp}, plus one union iteration) to achieve slot consolidation while maintaining isolation and joint dependency resolution

The loop must use absolute venv-path invocations (e.g. $v/bin/python, $v/bin/rebar-mcp), avoid source activate stacking, include rc accumulator with continue and exit logic, and never silently pass on failure
Metrics extra gains per-extra CI coverage for the first time; mcp (server transport, no _optional probe) gets validated by rebar-mcp --help boot check in its isolated iteration only
main-protection.snapshot.json must be updated to remove stale check names (per-extra and union job names) that would block emergency rollbacks via rollback-mirror-lock.sh
Checked-in test guards must assert loop contains exit $rc and continue with no activate, and that looped extra list covers all _optional.EXTRAS keys
